data.gender_notes: Kiron is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' meaning black or dark, Kiron is also associated with swiftness and heroism. In Hindu mythology, Kiron is the name of a celestial being, a warrior-god, and a companion of Lord Indra. The name Kiron carries the meaning “Black, Dark, Swift, Hero” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kiron usually hope their child will grow to embody black, dark, swift, hero and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name, with its profound origins, evokes a deep sense of pride, tradition, and commitment, integrating a unique sense of charm and character.

It embodies the energies of Krishna, the revered Hindu god associated with love, compassion, and divine love. Believed to symbolize swiftness, a Kiron is thought to possess the agility and resourcefulness of Lord Indra's celestial warrior, making it a powerful and inspiring name.
